## Checklist

- [ ] `gradle testDebugUnitTest` passes locally
- [ ] `gradle verifyRoborazziDebug` passes, or screenshots were re-recorded on purpose and are included
- [ ] New logic has unit tests; bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Colours, springs, durations and shapes come from `:core:designsystem`
- [ ] Interactive elements have content descriptions and 48 dp touch targets; reduced motion is respected
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data are committed
- [ ] Code is original or under a GPL-3.0-compatible licence with attribution
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing changes
